items.t: What Does Carvana (CVNA) Same Day Delivery Expansion Mean For Investors?
items.sum: Carvana (NYSE:CVNA) expanded same day vehicle delivery coverage to southern Maine, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island. The roll out extends the online used car retailer's e commerce and logistics network into additional New England markets.
